text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the passion she's now putting into her training, it's like she's become a completely different person.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing her effort, I'm inspired to do whatever it takes to help her reach the limits of her potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon is shocked by my behavior… At the same time, she seems moved by my constant enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A certain madness returns to her eyes as she mutters, "It's too early to give up," before suddenly withdrawing from the Gekkei Hai.
